derivation: from G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of the base of G939 (βάσις);
def: to cause to go down, i.e. precipitate

occurrences.text: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
